'Destockage' is the standard French e-commerce term for permanent stock clearance/outlet (literally 'de-stocking'), not a generic percent-off promo, so this passes the brief's Clearance test; no ambiguity flag needed on the parent row. Genuine site-exposed sub-structure: the Destockage shop itself links to 8 department-scoped child listings (Bureau Rangement / Canape Salon Sejour / Chambre Literie / Cuisine Salle de Bain / Decoration Textile / Gros Electromenager / Petit Electromenager / TV Son Multimedia), each confirmed to be a real filtered PLP (own H1, own RSC nbPages/productCount) -- preserved as parent grouping row + 8 leaf rows per brief Sec 3. QTY VERIFICATION: parent and every child's productCount was checked against the empirical page-count exhaustion formula ceil(productCount/60)==nbPages (page size 60, same as confirmed in the prior Home-Decor pass for this site) -- all 9 rows passed exactly. Parent total (5637) additionally cross-checked against the 'Vendu par' (Sold by) seller facet sum: Conforama 5617 + Partenaires (Mirakl marketplace) 20 = 5637, exact match. Children sum to 5603 vs parent's 5637 (34-unit gap, ~0.6%) -- consistent with normal session-to-session inventory drift already documented for this site in the prior pass (e.g. Mirrors: 3864 vs 3870), not an error. Counts include Conforama's own stock plus its Mirakl third-party marketplace inventory, which is what each URL itself reports, so kept per the 'qty is what the website itself reports' rule. Also checked and explicitly excluded as non-Clearance: boutique-promotions (generic temporary promotions/rebate-offer shop) and boutique-french-days (seasonal sale campaign) -- both lack any permanent-markdown/outlet signal and were not opened as candidates. Searched sitemap-categories.xml and sitemap-recherches.xml for outlet|solde|destockage|fin de serie|derniere chance terms -- no additional Clearance-type listings found beyond the boutique-destockage tree.
